about_the_game:
Welcome to the valley, where the fog not only veils the landscape but also blurs the line between what once was and what remained a fleeting fantasy.

In this remote mountain valley, cut off from the world and swallowed by endless mist, time loops without end. You follow forgotten paths that suddenly feel strangely familiar.

In the hidden corners of the valley, you recognize places from your childhood - forest trails, stone bridges. They awaken memories: old dreams, past fears, unfulfilled ambitions. Yet with them stirs something darker - beings born from pop culture, urban legends, and horror stories of the late ’70s and early ’80s, now standing before you as real threats. And even more dangerous are those adversaries that materialize from our own subconscious fears.

The Day I Will Die is a first-person action thriller with a dynamic, varied combat system. Using a diverse arsenal of weapons, you will confront enemies shaped by childhood fears and dark legends of the past. As you traverse the valley, step by step, you draw closer to understanding what truly happened - and what still waits behind the veil of mist. In the end, you will also face what we have created within ourselves as adults.

The Day I Will Die is a story about the passage of time, lost dreams, and the struggle to come to terms with what can no longer be changed.

Key Features:

  • An unforgettable atmosphere evoking the spirit of old tales, legends, and horror stories from the late ’70s and early ’80s.

  • A constant sense of danger and uncertainty in a world engulfed by mist.

  • Unique encounters with a wide variety of foes, fought with a rich arsenal of weapons.

  • A powerful story that will stay with you long after the game is over.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4690/ AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 3GB/ AMD RX 580 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 8700K/ AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: Trapped in a misty valley of endless time loops, confront echoes of your childhood and creatures from old tales and legends. Explore forgotten paths stirring subconscious fears, face nightmarish foes, and uncover a story of fading dreams and shadows of adulthood.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support
